promptGuard._comment: Phase 5 interim-AIDR prompt firewall (LLM Guard, github.com/protectai/llm-guard). DEFAULT OFF. When enabled, llm-adapter scans every assembled prompt (incl. injected tooluniverse:// tool-results) via the local LLM Guard service BEFORE it reaches any LLM provider. mode=enforce blocks on is_valid:false; mode=monitor logs only (recommended soak before enforce). failOpen:true => a down/erroring service ALLOWS the prompt (never cripple research). Token via env LLM_GUARD_AUTH_TOKEN or promptGuard.authToken in the gitignored llm-providers.local.json. HTTPS-only; TLS verified via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.
